items.text: Nvidia shares fell 23% this week, their worst week since the 2008 financial crisis, closing Friday at $125.53, down 14% on the day after Reuters reported an SEC accounting probe (Investing.com).

sources.title: Nvidia suffers worst week since 2008, as SEC probe report fuels post-Huang turmoil (Investing.com)
sources.quote: plunged 23% this week, marking their worst weekly performance since the 2008 financial crisis

sources.title: Nvidia suffers worst week since 2008, as SEC probe report fuels post-Huang turmoil (Investing.com)
sources.quote: The stock closed Friday at $125.53, down $20.45, or 14%, in its seventh consecutive weekly decline.

items.text: On Friday Reuters, citing two people briefed on the matter, reported that SEC enforcement staff are examining potential accounting issues at Nvidia; the SEC declined to comment and Nvidia did not immediately respond.

sources.title: Nvidia Shares Sink to 52-Week Low After Report SEC Is Probing Accounting (Decrypt)
sources.quote: Reuters, citing two people briefed on the matter, said the inquiry centers on potential accounting issues

sources.title: Nvidia's accounting is a focus of US SEC investigation, sources say (Reuters via The Standard)
sources.quote: SEC enforcement staff are scrutinizing potential accounting issues at the company

items.text: Nvidia shares were already down more than 6% on Friday before the Reuters report and were down about 13% afterward, according to LSEG data cited by Reuters.

sources.title: Nvidia's accounting is a focus of US SEC investigation, sources say (Reuters via The Standard)
sources.quote: They had been down more than 6% before Reuters published its report.

sources.title: Nvidia's accounting is a focus of US SEC investigation, sources say (Reuters via The Standard)
sources.quote: Prices of Nvidia shares extended losses and were down about 13% on Friday, according to LSEG data

items.text: Strong results did not stop the slide: Nvidia reported fiscal Q3 revenue of $115.8 billion on Tuesday, up 103% and above Wall Street's $109.2 billion estimate.

sources.title: Nvidia Just Demolished Earnings, but the Stock Is Still Plunging. The Reason Is Obvious. (Motley Fool)
sources.quote: representing 103% growth year over year and exceeding Wall Street's estimate of $109.2 billion

sources.title: Stock Market Today, Nov. 17: Nvidia Slides Ahead of Earnings but Soars in After Hours Trading (Motley Fool)
sources.quote: The semiconductor giant reported a 103% year-over-year increase in sales to $115.8 billion

items.text: Nvidia guided fourth-quarter revenue to $130 billion, plus or minus 3%, above analysts' expectations of about $125 billion.

sources.title: Nvidia Just Demolished Earnings, but the Stock Is Still Plunging. The Reason Is Obvious. (Motley Fool)
sources.quote: Nvidia forecasting $130 billion in revenue for the fourth quarter, plus or minus 3%

sources.title: Nvidia Just Demolished Earnings, but the Stock Is Still Plunging. The Reason Is Obvious. (Motley Fool)
sources.quote: Moreover, it also exceeds analysts' expectations of approximately $125 billion.

items.text: Nvidia's data center revenue rose 110% year over year and 21% from the previous quarter to $107.6 billion.

sources.title: Stock Market Today, Nov. 17: Nvidia Slides Ahead of Earnings but Soars in After Hours Trading (Motley Fool)
sources.quote: Its data center revenue rose 110% year over year and 21% from the previous quarter to $107.6 billion

items.text: Adjusted earnings per share rose 111% to $2.68, above the $2.47 estimate.

sources.title: Nvidia Just Demolished Earnings, but the Stock Is Still Plunging. The Reason Is Obvious. (Motley Fool)
sources.quote: Meanwhile, adjusted earnings per share (EPS) surged 111% to $2.68, comfortably exceeding Wall Street's estimate of $2.47.

items.text: The post-earnings bounce faded: shares rose as much as 3% in extended trading Tuesday, then Nvidia sank about 3% on Wednesday as the S&P 500 fell for a fifth straight day (Reuters, Bloomberg).

sources.title: Wall Street ends lower ahead of Nvidia results, focus turns to Anthropic debut (Reuters via News Tribune)
sources.quote: The company beat analyst estimates, and its shares rose by as much as 3 percent in extended trading.

sources.title: Stocks Fall on Nvidia Rout With Anthropic in Focus: Markets Wrap (Bloomberg via Swissinfo)
sources.quote: The chipmaker sank about 3%.

items.text: Leadership uncertainty continued: board chairman Harvey Jones said the board does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO, and Nvidia hired Heidrick & Struggles to find a permanent successor.

sources.quote: The Nvidia board does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO

sources.quote: Nvidia has retained executive search firm Heidrick & Struggles to identify a permanent successor

sources.quote: Nvidia's CFO and interim CEO Colette Kress

items.text: With its results Nvidia disclosed about $118 billion in financial guarantees, and said its Form 10-Q would be filed in the coming weeks rather than with earnings (Motley Fool).

reels.hook: Nvidia just had its worst week since 2008.
reels.why: An SEC accounting probe report on Friday piled onto a week of CEO turmoil and wiped out the post-earnings bounce.

reels.hook: Nvidia guided $130 billion. The stock fell anyway.
reels.why: Record revenue and a $130B guide couldn't outweigh governance and accounting worries.

reels.hook: Nvidia disclosed $118 billion in financial guarantees.
reels.why: Guarantees tied to data-center projects are now in focus as the SEC reportedly examines Nvidia's accounting.

reels.topic: Chip crash spreads to Broadcom and AMD
reels.hook: Broadcom and AMD both lost over 12% Friday.
reels.why: Nvidia's rout dragged the whole chip sector and pushed the Nasdaq down 5.13% in a day.

reels.hook: Markets now see a 95% chance the Fed hikes in December.
reels.why: Higher rates hit expensive tech stocks hardest, adding to the AI selloff.
